title: monoidal projection conjugate
statement: Let $C,D$ be monoidal categories, $F:C\to D$ a strong monoidal functor with tensorator $\mu_{A,B}:F(A)\otimes F(B)\to F(A\otimes B)$, and $a:F\dashv R$ an adjunction with counit $\epsilon$. Let $K,L\in C$ have an exact pairing, meaning evaluation $L\otimes K\to 1$ and coevaluation $1\to K\otimes L$ satisfying both triangle identities. Equip $F(K),F(L)$ with the pairing obtained by applying $F$ and its monoidal comparisons. The pairing gives tensor adjunctions $L\otimes -\dashv K\otimes -$ and $F(L)\otimes -\dashv F(K)\otimes -$. Conjugate the natural tensorator $F(-)$ followed by left tensoring with $F(L)\to F(L\otimes -)$ under the composite adjunctions $(L\otimes -)\mathbin{;}F\dashv R\mathbin{;}(K\otimes -)$ and $F\mathbin{;}(F(L)\otimes -)\dashv(F(K)\otimes -)\mathbin{;}R$. For every $E\in D$, its component $K\otimes R(E)\to R(F(K)\otimes E)$ equals the $a$-adjunct of $\mu_{K,R(E)}^{-1}$ followed by $F(K)\otimes\epsilon_E$.

proof.text: Expand the composite adjunction Hom equivalences and apply conjugateEquiv_counit. The tensor-Hom equivalence for the mapped pairing commutes with F, by expanding ExactPairing.map and applying the monoidal functor coherence laws. Naturality in the target then reduces the canonical transpose to the composite-adjunction counit. This is the local pairing_map calculation and the subsequent transposition in the Lean proof.

lean.statement:
theorem monoidal_projection_conjugate
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (R : D ⥤ C) [F.Monoidal] (a : F ⊣ R)
    (K L : C) [ExactPairing K L] (E : D) :
    (@conjugateEquiv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      ((tensorLeftAdjunction K L).comp a)
      (a.comp (@tensorLeftAdjunction D _ _ (F.obj K) (F.obj L)
        (ExactPairing.map F K L)))
      (Functor.Monoidal.commTensorLeft F L).hom).app E =
        (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F K (R.obj E)).inv ≫
            F.obj K ◁ a.counit.app E)
